operation.description:
Lists the suggestions on an issue. A suggestion is an agent-proposed change to an issue's type, labels, fields, assignees, or closed state that a maintainer can approve or dismiss.

By default only pending suggestions are returned. Use `state=all` to return suggestions in every state, or `state=<state>` to filter to a single state. Use `action=<action>` to return only suggestions for a specific change.

This endpoint is only available while the issue suggestions feature is enabled for the repository, and only supports issues, not pull requests.

Requires triage access to the repository.

parameters.description: Filter suggestions by the change they propose.
parameters.name: action

value.rationale: This looks like a bug report based on the stack trace in the description.
The report describes unexpected behaviour with reproduction steps.

#/components/parameters/issue-number.description: The number that identifies the issue.
#/components/parameters/issue-number.name: issue_number

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/page.name: page

#/components/parameters/per-page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/per-page.name: per_page

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/responses/validation_failed.description: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.

#/components/schemas/issue-suggestion.description: An agent-proposed change to an issue that a maintainer can approve or dismiss.

actor_id.description: The unique identifier of the actor that proposed the suggestion.

confidence.description: The actor's confidence level in the suggestion.

created_at.description: The time the suggestion was created.

id.description: The unique identifier of the suggestion.

issue_event_id.description: The identifier of the timeline event created when the suggestion was approved, when applicable.

issue_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue the suggestion applies to.

rationale.description: The rationale the actor provided for the suggestion.

resolved_by.description: The unique identifier of the user who approved or dismissed the suggestion.

target_id.description: The identifier of the target the change applies to (issue type, label, field, assignee, or duplicate issue), when applicable.

target_value.description: The proposed value, when applicable. An array for multi-select field suggestions.

updated_at.description: The time the suggestion was last updated.

#/components/schemas/issue-suggestion.title: Issue Suggestion
